command: pre-registration: S2RGT, scene 2 (LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5) on NEW states, layout O: SR 68's ReGuide port with tracking of the held mug (rgt, rendered depth) and with tracking + table-plane depth (rgtp), against I and SR 68's rgp, on frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY) and pi0 (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 69)

metrics.arms:
everything not named here is s2rg.py's client, line for line: entities, round declaration, statistics
results/flawed/s2rg/rg_stats_s2.json, registration at the first gated step, re-detection at ProprioHeld onsets, Hp's held-mug
identity rule (nearest perceived mug within HELD_R = .08 m of the hand), the interaction state "the instructed mug is held", the
hand-back handling; prompt and images never changed):
  - rgp   SR 68's arm: OWLv2 (s2fix3_det sidecar) + rendered depth + camera calibration (s2fix3.Percept, constants unchanged).  While
          attached, the instructed mug follows the hand rigidly from the offset fixed at the attachment (no tracking).  Run through
          this file's client with tracking off (the decision path is s2rg.py's; only logging is added).
  - rgt   rgp + TRACKING: while the instructed mug is attached, OWLv2 re-detects the mugs every TRACK_K control steps, from the
          attachment step on.  Each detected mug box is localised by s2fix3.Percept.points (rendered depth, inner-half median) +
          CAL_HELD_DEPTH (the held-mug constant, fitted in `pcheck` on development states); the measurement is the localised box
          nearest the current estimate in xy, accepted only within GATE_XY = 3 cm of it (innovation gate).  An accepted
          measurement replaces the estimate's xy; its z stays the rigid estimate's (hand height + the offset fixed at the
          attachment).  The hand-frame offset is re-anchored to the result, so between measurements the mug follows the hand from
          the last one, and the carry (rg.py, unchanged) steers the TRACKED centre to the plate.  No accepted candidate: the
          estimate is kept (logged).
          DEVELOPMENT REVISION (after the smoke on SR 68's smoke states, before the prereg row): the first version took the
          measurement's full 3D point and Hp's hand-centred rule (nearest the hand within HELD_R).  In the smoke the measured
          height ran away (z error -7 to -70 cm within a carry: a low estimate makes the carry lift the hand, the next detection is
          worse) and wrong boxes were taken (xy jumps 5-9 cm); rgtp's held plane from the demonstrated grasp offset was 3 cm low
          from the attachment on (the VLA grasps lower than the demos), giving 4-5 cm xy bias.  Hence xy-only updates, the 3 cm
          gate, and rgtp's plane height from the rigid z.
  - rgtp  rgt with the rendered depth REPLACED by table-plane depth (no depth render anywhere in the arm): a resting mug = the camera
          ray through its box's bottom-centre cut with the table plane z = Z_TABLE, + CAL_MUG_PLANE; a plate = PLATE_METHOD's ray
          (box centre, or inner side edge + the plate radius) cut with the same plane, + CAL_PLATE_PLANE; the held mug = the ray
          through its box centre cut with the horizontal plane at the mug's mid height, which comes from proprioception (the rigid
          estimate's z, i.e. hand height + the offset fixed at the attachment, + the mesh mid height), + CAL_HELD_PLANE's xy
          (fitted in `pcheck` with the plane from the demonstrated grasp offset, z error .33 cm there); same gate and update as rgt.  Camera intrinsics and extrinsics (sc_pu.cam_model) stay: the remaining
          assumption.  Z_TABLE is a one-off calibration on development states: the median simulator height of the mugs' bottoms
          (body z + mesh bottom) at the settled start.
  - Every constant above comes from `pcheck` on DEVELOPMENT states (SR 68's states, seeds 980000 + k, none in this probe's 60),
    before the prereg row: results/flawed/s2rgt/pcheck.json.  PLATE_METHOD is chosen there by a fixed rule (the lower split-half
    median xy error).  TRACK_K = 5 (one OWLv2 call per 5 control steps; cost, not tuned).

metrics.labels: NEW states (LIBERO sampler on K1's BDDL, seeds 990000 + k, k = 0-59, none equal to an SR 50-68 state), branches seed_base 48000000 + 1000 k; layout O; tasks K1, K2, N1, N2; client seed 7, --bind track.  Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY; pp_serve_purify --model pi05 --mode intact --comp= --seed 13) and frozen pi0 (SECONDARY; serve_guided --mode ours --seed 13, BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero).  Arms per model: I (s2.py client), rgp (SR 68's arm: ReGuide on OWLv2 + rendered depth + calibration, rigid held-mug estimate), rgt (rgp + tracking of the held mug every 5 control steps, rendered depth), rgtp (rgt with table-plane depth instead of rendered depth; camera calibration kept).  Success = the BDDL goal.  Matrices [task, state].  Paired bootstrap over states, tasks fixed (s2.boot2_states, B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0); CI = 2.5 / 97.5).  Registered contrasts per model: (V1) rgt - rgp on N1: TRACKING HELPS iff lo > 0; TRACKING HURTS iff hi < 0; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  (V2, the de-privilege cost) rgtp - rgt on N1+N2 and, separately, on K1+K2: EQUIVALENT iff the CI lies inside [-.10, +.10]; else COST iff hi < 0; else GAIN iff lo > 0; else INCONCLUSIVE.  (V3) rgtp - I: dN on N1+N2, dK on K1+K2: FIX WORKS iff dN lo > 0 AND dK lo > -.05; PARTIAL iff exactly one holds; FAILS iff neither (SR 62-68's rule); BAR: MEETS BAR iff rgtp's N1+N2 >= .50 AND dN lo > 0, else BELOW BAR; descriptive beside it: the state-bootstrap CI of rgtp's N1+N2.  PRIMARY: V1-V3 on pi0.5.  SR 50's floor: a model is TESTABLE iff its I K1+K2 >= .70 on these states; a NOT TESTABLE model's labels read NOT TESTABLE with the rule's outcome descriptive.  MECHANISM (registered, descriptive): (m1) per arm, the share of N1 episodes whose white mug ends on no plate (final LIBERO On predicates), with rgt - rgp and rgtp - rgp paired over states; (m2) per arm (rgp, rgt, rgtp), the held-mug estimate against the simulator at each release of the attached instructed mug (ProprioHeld off): xy error, median and 90th percentile, on N1 and over all tasks, and the share of releases whose estimate vs whose simulator mug lies within the controller's release region (dest_xy, omega); (m3) tracking: measurements, the share accepted, the measurement's and the rigid estimate's xy error against the simulator at the same step.  SECONDARY: the same FIX / BAR labels for rgp and rgt; rgt - rgp and rgtp - rgp on N1+N2 and K1+K2 (GAIN iff lo > 0, COST iff hi < 0, else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE).  Descriptive: registration error of each arm against the simulator (target plate, other plate, instructed mug, every mug; side right), onset held-mug identity, ReGuide's transports, episode length and time-outs.  C1: the reference planner (s2.plan_episode via s2cue3.ref_eps, unchanged) on the main states; MET iff its N1-N2 success >= .80.
metrics.prediction:
S2RGT predictions (SR 69), written 2026-11-16 BEFORE any job of this probe (development check, states, smoke or main), and before
experiments/s2rgt.py was written.  Nothing of this probe has been run.

What is tested.  SR 68's ported ReGuide on scene 2 (LIBERO-10 LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5) left two problems: its perception is privileged
(OWLv2 boxes + RENDERED depth + camera calibration), and its N1 is low (rgp .417 against rgo .833 on pi0.5), which SR 68 found
consistent with rgp's untracked rigid held-mug estimate (34 of 60 N1 white mugs on no plate) but never tested.  Arms:
  I     the frozen policy alone.
  rgp   SR 68's arm (replication; same controller, perception and rules).
  rgt   rgp + tracking of the held mug during the attachment: OWLv2 re-detects the held mug every k control steps and its tracked
        centre replaces the rigid estimate (the hand-frame offset is re-anchored to the measurement), so the carry steers the tracked
        mug, not the assumed rigid offset, to the plate.  Rendered depth kept: rgt - rgp isolates problem (b).
  rgtp  rgt with rendered depth replaced by table-plane depth: each box's camera ray (bottom-centre for a mug on the table, centre
        for a plate) cut with the known table-plane height; the held mug's height from proprioception (hand height + the grasp
        offset).  Camera intrinsics and extrinsics stay (the remaining assumption).
Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY), pi0 (SECONDARY).  60 new states (seeds 990000 + k), layout O, tasks K1 K2 N1 N2.

What I expect mechanistically.
- If SR 68's account is right, rgp's carry ends with the real white mug a few cm off the estimate (the grasp slips / the mug swings
  in the hand), outside the right plate's release region; tracking should cut the release-time error and move N1 toward rgo.  The
  risks: (1) the held-mug box is partly occluded by the gripper, so the re-detected centre is biased or noisy (OWLv2 + inner-half
  depth median picks up finger pixels), and tracking could even hurt; (2) the N1 residual may not be the estimate at all but the
  policy after the hand-back (pi0.5 re-grasps / carries the mug back toward the left plate, SR 57-61's routing), which tracking
  does not touch.  rgo's .833 says the estimate matters, but rgo also uses simulator poses for the registration and the onset.
  I expect part of the gap to close, not all.
- rgtp: plane-cut localisation of a resting mug from the box bottom edge should be about as good as the depth median for the plates
  and mugs (1-2 cm); the held mug from a plane at hand height is rougher.  I expect a small cost, within the band on K1+K2 and
  probably within it on N1+N2.

Point predictions, pi0.5 (60 states per task):
  I     K1 ~1.00  K2 ~1.00  N1 ~.00  N2 ~.00.
  rgp   K1+K2 ~.99, N1 ~.42, N2 ~.97, N1+N2 ~.70 (replicates SR 68 within +-.08 on N1+N2: 80%).
  rgt   K1+K2 ~.99, N1 ~.60, N2 ~.97, N1+N2 ~.78.
  rgtp  K1+K2 ~.97, N1 ~.55, N2 ~.93, N1+N2 ~.74.
Registered contrasts, pi0.5:
  V1 rgt - rgp on N1: point +.18.  TRACKING HELPS (lo > 0): 55%; NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE: 40%; TRACKING HURTS: 5%.
  V2 rgtp - rgt: N1+N2 point -.04, K1+K2 point -.02.  K1+K2 EQUIVALENT (CI inside +-.10): 80%.  N1+N2 EQUIVALENT: 45% (the CI
     on N1+N2 is wide, about +-.09 around the point, so it may cross the band without a cost); COST (hi < 0) on N1+N2: 20%.
  V3 rgtp - I: FIX WORKS 90%; MEETS BAR (N1+N2 >= .50 and lo > 0) 85%; the state-bootstrap lower bound of rgtp's N1+N2 >= .50:
     75%.
Mechanism, pi0.5 (N1, share of white mugs on no plate): rgp ~.55 (SR 68 .567), rgt ~.30, rgtp ~.35.  Held-mug xy error at the
  release (estimate vs simulator, median): rgp ~3 cm, rgt ~1.5 cm, rgtp ~2 cm.  If V1 reads NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE while rgt's release
  error is clearly below rgp's, SR 68's account is wrong (the residual lies after the hand-back): I give that 30%.
pi0 (SECONDARY): I K1+K2 ~.87 (TESTABLE 90%).  rgp N1 ~.43, N2 ~.95; rgt N1 ~.55; rgtp N1 ~.50.  V1 TRACKING HELPS 40%.  V2
  K1+K2 EQUIVALENT 70%.  V3 rgtp FIX WORKS 80%, MEETS BAR 75%.
Perception (rgtp registration, against the simulator, logged only): target plate xy error median < 1.5 cm (70%); instructed mug
  xy error median < 2 cm (70%); target side right >= .97 (90%).
C1 (reference planner, N1-N2 >= .80): UNMET 60% (SR 68 .758, the planner's N1 ~.57).
